assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The patient has a diagnosis of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the context of the patient's known atherosclerotic heart disease and atrial fibrillation.
